title: System/370 evidence source catalogue
summary: Source IDs used by opcode/rule records. Prefer IBM Principles of Operation for architecture, Hercules as an independent executable reference, and project journal evidence for exact historical MVT behavior.
rules: IBM documentation defines the target architecture.
Executable-reference behavior is corroboration, not authority over the IBM architecture.
Project evidence proves what the ooRexx emulator and historical guest did at one exact state; it does not generalize beyond its claim scope.
